workbuddy-progress.title: WorkBuddy team progress
workbuddy-progress.intro: Follow saved WorkBuddy submissions in this project and open the linked task delivery or the original execution.
workbuddy-progress.boundary: This view reads platform records without querying WorkBuddy. Delivery, independent tests and acceptance are tracked separately.
workbuddy-progress.denied: Your access to the selected progress could not be confirmed. Protected records were cleared.
workbuddy-progress.invalid: The returned progress does not match this project or page. Read the saved progress again.
workbuddy-progress.failed: Saved WorkBuddy progress could not be read. Try again.
workbuddy-progress.stale: Showing the last loaded records. Read again to confirm progress and reopen links.
workbuddy-progress.empty_detail: Once a submission is recorded for this project, its saved progress will appear here.
workbuddy-progress.empty_attention: Search finished. No saved submissions in this search need attention.
workbuddy-progress.observation_failed: The last WorkBuddy query failed. The previous observation is shown.
workbuddy-progress.empty_batch: No submissions in this batch need attention. Continue searching the current scope.
workbuddy-progress.invalid_filter: This WorkBuddy filter link is invalid. Select a project filter to continue.
workbuddy-progress.invalid_task: This WorkBuddy task link is invalid. Clear the task scope to view project progress.
workbuddy-progress.empty_task_title: No saved cloud submissions for this task
workbuddy-progress.empty_task_detail: Saved WorkBuddy submissions from this task will appear here.
workbuddy-progress.empty_task_batch: No submissions for this task in this batch. Continue searching the current scope.
